Package com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.vision.sim

Class LimelightTargetTranslator

java.lang.Object
com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.vision.sim.LimelightTargetTranslator
public class LimelightTargetTranslator extends Object
Translates a PhotonPipelineResult into the equivalent LimelightFrame.

All the semantics live here: the sign changes between conventions, the computation of the metadata Limelight appends to botpose (tag count, span, average distance and area) and the two pose estimates:

  • MegaTag1 (botpose*): multi-tag PnP if two or more tags are visible, and otherwise the least ambiguous tag. It uses no external information.
  • MegaTag2 (botpose_orb*): constrained PnP pinning the yaw the robot code wrote to robot_orientation_set. If the robot does not write that key, this estimate does not exist, exactly as with real hardware.
